admission.justification: Removing the dashboard's sidebar without ending the plugin's load-time collapse would leave the host's list closed; ending the collapse without a one-time migration would keep old stored 'closed' state forever; and keeping the Parent pill where the host gives no live value would leave a control that cannot act. The members together promise one navigation that behaves and one that never lies.

guarantee: The dashboard draws no chat navigation of its own; the host's list owns opening, closing and remembering its state on the Chats page, and the only navigation the plugin still offers is the Parent control for a chat whose live front value the unchanged bridge can check, so no control is shown that cannot act.
title: The host's list is the only chat navigation and no dead control is shown
